register_metadata.title: Phase 8.6 Format-Diverse Multilingual Evaluation Corpus Source Register

candidates.title: Economic Survey of Maharashtra 2023-24 (OpenCity Mislabeled Resource)
candidates.publisher: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Planning Department, Government of Maharashtra
candidates.provenance: Official legislative document presented to State Legislature; hosted on OpenCity.
candidates.license_evidence: Government of Maharashtra open data / NDSAP public use.
candidates.rejection_reason: Forensic PyMuPDF analysis revealed document is English edition (PREFACE_23_24_E_30524.doc) with 888,339 chars and 0.0% Devanagari. Preserved on disk solely as negative evidence of upstream catalog mislabeling.

candidates.title: Annual Report 2023-2024 - Ministry of Education (Hindi)
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Education, Government of India (Department of Higher Education)
candidates.provenance: Official Government of India administrative report presented to Parliament.
candidates.license_evidence: NDSAP / Government of India open publication.
candidates.rejection_reason: Portal uses client-side Next.js React SPA with headless WordPress REST API requiring internal auth tokens. Direct scripted HTTP requests time out or fail. Halted under DEC-P8.6-FD-10.

candidates.title: National Education Policy 2020 — Hindi Edition (राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति २०२०)
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Education, Government of India
candidates.repository: Ministry of Education (Legacy Drupal / Redesigned Next.js Portal)
candidates.provenance: Official National Policy of India gazette publication.
candidates.license_evidence: Government of India public policy document; public domain.
candidates.rejection_reason: Legacy Drupal static endpoints (/sites/upload_files/mhrd/files/nep/NEP_final_HINDI.pdf and /sites/default/files/NEP_Final_Hindi.pdf) return HTTP 404. Mirrors on NCERT connection reset; Archive.org snapshots time out over network.

candidates.title: Economic Survey of Maharashtra 2025-26 (Marathi Edition) (महाराष्ट्राची आर्थिक पाहणी २०२५-२६)
candidates.publisher: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Planning Department, Government of Maharashtra
candidates.provenance: Official state economic survey report presented to Maharashtra State Legislature.
candidates.license_evidence: Government of Maharashtra open publication under NDSAP.

candidates.title: Marathi Vachva (मराठी वाचवा) — Linguistic Guide
candidates.provenance: Community linguistic guide on Marathi orthography.
candidates.license_evidence: GPLv3 in repo LICENSE file (not registered in GitHub API).
candidates.rejection_reason: Single short article of ~1,500 words; insufficient scale to establish comprehensive evaluation benchmarks.

candidates.title: mahGRs Collection
candidates.provenance: Purported GitHub repository of Maharashtra Government Resolutions.
candidates.rejection_reason: GitHub API and web requests return HTTP 404: Not Found. Account/repo does not exist.

candidates.title: Microsoft PhiCookBook Marathi Translation
candidates.provenance: Microsoft AI developer documentation translated into Marathi.
candidates.rejection_reason: Contains .co-op-translator.json; forensically confirmed as machine-translated software documentation. Fails DEC-P8.6-FD-01 authenticity standard.

candidates.title: Munshi Premchand — Godan (गोदान)
candidates.license_evidence: Public Domain (Indian Copyright Act term expired) / CC BY-SA 4.0.
candidates.semantic_quality: HIGHEST_POSSIBLE (~200,000 words of authentic literary Hindi prose across 36 chapters)

candidates.title: Mahatma Jotirao Phule — Shetkaryacha Asud (शेतकऱ्याचा असूड)
candidates.provenance: Foundational 19th-century Marathi socio-economic treatise on agrarian economy; published 1883.
candidates.semantic_quality: HIGHEST_POSSIBLE (Authentic, high-register historical Marathi prose with extensive agricultural and economic discourse)
